change: Every active checkpoint revalidates the snapshotted signed Gym plan with the current controller role, original journal and exact plan commitment; candidate freeze has a final active check. No registry, ledger, authority or publication path added.

counterexamples.cases: Revocation and controller-role loss before first task, during a bounded step, after a completed outcome and at candidate selection. Before the fix all eight cases continued or froze after authority loss.

asserted_boundaries: original signed plan is retained unchanged
failed-or-uncertain terminal record survives revocation and role loss
no subsequent training steps or candidate freeze after a failed checkpoint
one unknown C compute liability remains, paid amount zero, no A/B charges or additional reservation
revoked or role-less plan cannot retry or acquire a new journal event
normal and unrelated-evaluator-revocation controls still complete frozen training
test_maintenance: After pre-fix reproduction, Ruff formatting changed only layout of the new test; all ten cases and assertions were retained.
scope: Actual local synthetic workflow execution, signatures and durable records. No actual provider calls, customer acceptance, live ENS authentication, payments or held native-source probes.
